label: Field-Level Encryption (FLE)
type: a client-side, optional add-on library (java-couchbase-encryption or equivalent) that encrypts specific JSON field VALUES inside the application before a document is sent to Couchbase Server, using an application-managed pluggable sdk:fle-keyring - NOT the same mechanism as encryption:native-encryption-at-rest (Couchbase Server's own server-side, server-key-managed, whole-bucket disk encryption); the two share only the word 'encryption'
note: Recurs across concept-docs/encryption.json (java-sdk), howtos/encrypting-using-sdk.json, ref/glossary.json, and python-sdk/concept-docs/encryption.json. The java-sdk/concept-docs/encryption.json record explicitly checked and rejected reuse of encryption:native-encryption-at-rest/encryption:data-encryption-key/encryption:master-password before minting this id - the same same-word-different-thing collision pattern already documented five times in the role:* family. Client-side, field-scoped, app-managed keys vs. server-side, bucket-scoped, server-managed key hierarchy.
